note: The official promotions listing is https://www.rcbc.com/promos (page title Find Great Bank Promos in the Philippines Today, heading RCBC Promos). It is in English. Each page server-renders six li.card-item tiles. Pagination links use /Promos/page/{n}. Both Previous and Next use the class prev, so the recipe follows div.pagination ul > li:last-child a (the Next control). A first-run test that used li.prev a stopped after page 2 because that selector matches Previous first. On 24 Nov 2026 the pager showed pages 1 to 15. Many tiles are Hexagon Club merchant discounts; some are MyDebit (debit) campaigns. Detail pages often put promo mechanics in an image and terms in section.generic-template-content. Credit card product and offer pages on rcbccredit.com are not in official_domains and must not be fetched.
